name: Power Jammer - Dodge
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Dodge capability.

61006.name: Power Boost III · Dodge
61006.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
In combat, the enemy's Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
